description:
A real email to a stranger from the workspace's inbox, in the owner's name. Any time, whatever Auto outreach says. Not on the free trial.
action:
- pitch(id, force?): Book a prepared pitch into the send queue: out in the next business-hours slot, then Sightkick runs the follow-ups and replies. One scoring under the Opportunity floor (which steers Sightkick's own pitches and the app's buttons) goes with force: true.
- reply(id, body?, to?): One reply now, threaded under their mail, on a thread mail went out on (a first email is a pitch): body, or the waiting draft (an offer's answer included). To whoever wrote last, or any address in to. Refused for an address on the do-not-contact list, or when the thread's inbox is gone. Can't be undone.
- follow_up(id, body?): Send the owed follow-up at the send window's next opening.
name: send_outreach
title: Send outreach email
